```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

source("favorability_test.R")
source("data_helpers.R")
```

# Analysis parameters

```{r params, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
cat(sprintf("- **Data directory:** `%s`\n", params$data_dir))
cat(sprintf("- **Output directory:** `%s`\n", ifelse(is.null(params$output_dir), params$data_dir, params$output_dir)))
cat(sprintf("- **Machine ratings:** `%s`\n", ifelse(is.null(params$machine_ratings_path), file.path(params$data_dir, "machineRatings.jsonl"), params$machine_ratings_path)))
cat(sprintf("- **Bootstrap by:** %s\n", params$bootstrap_by))
cat(sprintf("- **N bootstrap (favorability):** %d\n", params$n_boot))
cat(sprintf("- **N bootstrap (correlation CI):** %d\n", params$n_boot_corr))
cat(sprintf("- **Unblind vendors:** %s\n", ifelse(params$unblind, "yes", "no")))
```

# Load human ratings data

Replicate the data loading from analysis.Rmd.

```{r load_human}
if (is.null(params$data_dir)) stop("`data_dir` parameter is required")
data_dir <- params$data_dir

assignments <- read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "blinded_qa_assignments.csv"))
questions   <- read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "blinded_qa_questions.csv"))
ratings     <- read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "blinded_ratings.csv"))
user_registrations  <- read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "recruitment_combined.csv"))
users       <- read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "blinded_users.csv"))
users <- get_eligible_users(users, user_registrations, user_stratification = NULL)
prior_users_path <- file.path(data_dir, "blinded_prior_users.csv")
prior_users <- if (file.exists(prior_users_path)) read_csv(prior_users_path) else NULL

qa_ratings_human <- build_qa_ratings(ratings, assignments, questions, users, prior_users = prior_users)
qa_ratings_human <- apply_inclusion_criteria(qa_ratings_human)
```

# Load vendor blinding mapping

```{r load_mapping}
secret_mapping <- read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "secret_mapping.csv"))
provider_to_vendor <- setNames(secret_mapping$vendor, secret_mapping$provider)

# Vendor display names: blinded (A/B/C/D) by default, unblinded if params$unblind
vendor_display_names <- c("A" = "A", "B" = "B", "C" = "C", "D" = "D")
if (params$unblind) {
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(secret_mapping))) {
    code <- secret_mapping$vendor[i]
    name <- secret_mapping$provider[i]
    vendor_display_names[code] <- case_when(
      grepl("openevidence", name, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "OE",
      grepl("gpt", name, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "GPT",
      grepl("claude|opus", name, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Claude",
      grepl("gemini", name, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Gemini",
      TRUE ~ name
    )
  }
}
```

# Load and process machine ratings

Machine ratings are joined to assignments via `assignmentId` to get the
question_id and blinded slot vendors.

```{r load_machine}
machine_ratings_path <- if (!is.null(params$machine_ratings_path)) {
  params$machine_ratings_path
} else {
  file.path(data_dir, "machineRatings.jsonl")
}
machine_raw <- stream_in(file(machine_ratings_path), verbose = FALSE)

choices_df <- machine_raw$choices
choices_df$row_id <- seq_len(nrow(choices_df))

machine_long <- machine_raw %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  select(row_id, assignment_id = assignmentId, grader, variant, subversion) %>%
  left_join(
    choices_df %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = -row_id, names_to = "axis", values_to = "choice"),
    by = "row_id"
  ) %>%
  select(-row_id)

machine_long <- machine_long %>%
  inner_join(
    assignments %>% select(assignment_id = id, question_id, slot_a_vendor, slot_b_vendor),
    by = "assignment_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(grader_vendor = provider_to_vendor[grader])

machine_long <- machine_long %>%
  mutate(
    winner = case_when(
      choice %in% c("strongly_a", "slightly_a") ~ slot_a_vendor,
      choice %in% c("strongly_b", "slightly_b") ~ slot_b_vendor,
      choice == "tie" ~ NA_character_
    ),
    loser = case_when(
      choice %in% c("strongly_a", "slightly_a") ~ slot_b_vendor,
      choice %in% c("strongly_b", "slightly_b") ~ slot_a_vendor,
      choice == "tie" ~ NA_character_
    ),
    is_tie = choice == "tie"
  )

cat(sprintf("Total machine ratings: %d\n", nrow(machine_long)))
cat(sprintf("Unique graders: %s\n", paste(unique(machine_long$grader), collapse = ", ")))
```

# Filter to text-only rendering (matching primary analysis)

The primary analysis uses `qa_text_only` subversion. For machine judges, we use
`variant == "text_only"` to match. We also restrict to the same subversion.

```{r filter_text_only}
n_na_choice <- sum(is.na(machine_long$choice))
cat(sprintf("Dropping %d ratings with NA choice\n", n_na_choice))

machine_text_only <- machine_long %>%
  filter(variant == "text_only", subversion == "qa_text_only", !is.na(choice))

cat(sprintf("Machine ratings after filtering to text_only/qa_text_only: %d\n", nrow(machine_text_only)))
```

# Compute human favorability scores (reference)

```{r human_favorability_helpers}
prepare_one_vs_rest_df <- function(df, vendor) {
  df %>%
    filter(slot_a_vendor == vendor | slot_b_vendor == vendor) %>%
    mutate(
      outcome = case_when(
        winner == vendor ~ 1L,
        loser == vendor ~ -1L,
        is_tie ~ 0L
      )
    ) %>%
    select(question_id, outcome)
}

run_favorability_analysis_simple <- function(df, axis_name, n_boot = 0,
                                             seed = 42, bootstrap_by = "question") {
  set.seed(seed)
  axis_df <- df %>% filter(axis == axis_name)
  if (nrow(axis_df) == 0) return(tibble())

  vendors <- sort(unique(c(axis_df$slot_a_vendor, axis_df$slot_b_vendor)))

  map_dfr(vendors, function(v) {
    test_df <- prepare_one_vs_rest_df(axis_df, v)
    if (nrow(test_df) == 0) return(NULL)

    fav_score <- get_favorability_score(test_df$outcome)

    if (n_boot > 0) {
      test_df$user_id <- seq_len(nrow(test_df))
      test_result <- run_favorability_test(test_df, n_boot = n_boot, ci_level = 0.95,
                                           bootstrap_by = bootstrap_by)
      ci_lower <- test_result$ci_lower
      ci_upper <- test_result$ci_upper
    } else {
      ci_lower <- NA_real_
      ci_upper <- NA_real_
    }

    tibble(
      vendor = v,
      wins = sum(test_df$outcome == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      ties = sum(test_df$outcome == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      losses = sum(test_df$outcome == -1, na.rm = TRUE),
      n = nrow(test_df),
      favorability = fav_score,
      ci_lower = ci_lower,
      ci_upper = ci_upper
    )
  })
}
```

```{r human_favorability}
human_text_only <- qa_ratings_human %>% filter(subversion == "qa_text_only")
axes <- c("accuracy", "clinical_utility", "authoritativeness", "completeness", "verifiability")

human_favorability <- map_dfr(axes, function(ax) {
  run_favorability_analysis_simple(human_text_only, ax, n_boot = params$n_boot,
                                   bootstrap_by = params$bootstrap_by) %>%
    mutate(axis = ax, judge = "human")
})

human_favorability %>%
  select(axis, vendor, favorability, ci_lower, ci_upper) %>%
  mutate(
    favorability_fmt = sprintf("%.1f%% [%.1f%%, %.1f%%]",
                               100 * favorability, 100 * ci_lower, 100 * ci_upper)
  ) %>%
  select(axis, vendor, favorability_fmt) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = axis, values_from = favorability_fmt) %>%
  kable(caption = "Human expert favorability scores (reference)") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))
```

# Compute judge favorability scores

For each LLM judge, compute one-vs-rest favorability scores.

```{r judge_favorability}
graders <- unique(machine_text_only$grader)

judge_favorability <- map_dfr(graders, function(g) {
  judge_df <- machine_text_only %>% filter(grader == g)

  map_dfr(axes, function(ax) {
    run_favorability_analysis_simple(judge_df, ax, n_boot = params$n_boot,
                                     bootstrap_by = params$bootstrap_by) %>%
      mutate(axis = ax, judge = g)
  })
})
```

# Compute jury favorability scores

The jury aggregates ratings by averaging Likert scores across judges, then
determining win/tie/lose based on the average.

```{r jury_favorability}
choice_to_score <- c(strongly_a = -2, slightly_a = -1, tie = 0, slightly_b = 1, strongly_b = 2)

jury_ratings <- machine_text_only %>%
  mutate(score = choice_to_score[choice]) %>%
  group_by(question_id, slot_a_vendor, slot_b_vendor, axis) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_score = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_judges = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    winner = case_when(
      avg_score < -0.5 ~ slot_a_vendor,
      avg_score > 0.5 ~ slot_b_vendor,
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    loser = case_when(
      avg_score < -0.5 ~ slot_b_vendor,
      avg_score > 0.5 ~ slot_a_vendor,
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    is_tie = abs(avg_score) <= 0.5
  )

jury_favorability <- map_dfr(axes, function(ax) {
  run_favorability_analysis_simple(jury_ratings, ax, n_boot = params$n_boot,
                                   bootstrap_by = params$bootstrap_by) %>%
    mutate(axis = ax, judge = "jury")
})
```

# Combine all favorability results

```{r combine_favorability}
all_favorability <- bind_rows(
  human_favorability,
  judge_favorability,
  jury_favorability
)

all_favorability %>%
  select(judge, axis, vendor, favorability) %>%
  mutate(favorability = round(100 * favorability, 1)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = vendor, values_from = favorability) %>%
  arrange(axis, judge) %>%
  kable(caption = "One-vs-rest favorability (%) by judge and axis") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))
```

# Compute Kendall's tau correlation: judge vs human

For each judge (and jury), compute Kendall's tau correlation between the
judge's favorability scores and the human expert's scores. We use Kendall's tau
since we only have 4 vendors to rank. We compute per-axis correlations and then
average across axes, bootstrapping to get meaningful CIs.

```{r kendall_correlation}
compute_kendall_vs_human <- function(fav_df) {
  human_df <- fav_df %>% filter(judge == "human") %>% select(axis, vendor, human_fav = favorability)

  fav_df %>%
    filter(judge != "human") %>%
    left_join(human_df, by = c("axis", "vendor")) %>%
    group_by(judge, axis) %>%
    summarise(
      kendall = cor(favorability, human_fav, method = "kendall"),
      n_vendors = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

compute_avg_kendall_vs_human <- function(fav_df) {
  per_axis <- compute_kendall_vs_human(fav_df)
  per_axis %>%
    group_by(judge) %>%
    summarise(
      avg_kendall = mean(kendall, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_axes = sum(!is.na(kendall)),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

kendall_per_axis <- compute_kendall_vs_human(all_favorability)
kendall_avg <- compute_avg_kendall_vs_human(all_favorability)

kendall_per_axis %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = axis, values_from = kendall, names_prefix = "tau_") %>%
  kable(caption = "Per-axis Kendall's tau of judge favorability vs human expert (n=4 vendors each)",
        digits = 3) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))
```

# Average Kendall's tau across axes

```{r kendall_summary}
kendall_avg %>%
  arrange(desc(avg_kendall)) %>%
  kable(caption = "Average Kendall's tau across all axes by judge",
        digits = 3,
        col.names = c("Judge", "Avg Kendall's tau", "N axes")) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))
```

# Grader-Gradee Win Difference Heatmaps

Create heatmaps showing win difference (favorability) scores where rows are graders
(judges) and columns are gradees (vendors being rated).

```{r heatmap_setup}
library(cowplot)

# Define display labels
axis_labels <- c(
  accuracy = "Accuracy",
  clinical_utility = "Clinical utility",
  authoritativeness = "Source quality",
  completeness = "Completeness",
  verifiability = "Verifiability"
)

# Define grader display names (provider -> display name)
grader_display_names <- c()
for (i in seq_len(nrow(secret_mapping))) {
  provider <- secret_mapping$provider[i]
  if (params$unblind) {
    grader_display_names[provider] <- case_when(
      grepl("gpt", provider, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "GPT",
      grepl("claude|opus", provider, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Claude",
      grepl("gemini", provider, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Gemini",
      TRUE ~ provider
    )
  } else {
    grader_display_names[provider] <- secret_mapping$vendor[i]
  }
}

# Fixed ordering: GPT, Gemini, Claude, Human specialist for graders (Y-axis)
grader_display_order <- c("GPT", "Gemini", "Claude", "Expert")
# Fixed ordering: GPT, Gemini, Claude, OE for gradees (X-axis)
gradee_display_order <- c("GPT", "Gemini", "Claude", "OE")

# Map graders (providers) to their vendor code (for diagonal highlighting)
grader_to_vendor <- setNames(
  provider_to_vendor[unique(machine_text_only$grader)],
  unique(machine_text_only$grader)
)
grader_to_vendor["human"] <- NA
```

```{r heatmap_data}
# Reshape favorability data into grader-gradee matrix format
heatmap_data <- all_favorability %>%
  mutate(
    grader = judge,
    gradee = vendor,
    win_diff_pct = 100 * favorability,
    ci_lower_pct = 100 * ci_lower,
    ci_upper_pct = 100 * ci_upper,
    # Get vendor code for grader (for diagonal check)
    grader_vendor_code = case_when(
      grader == "human" ~ NA_character_,
      grader == "jury" ~ NA_character_,
      TRUE ~ grader_to_vendor[grader]
    ),
    is_diagonal = !is.na(grader_vendor_code) & grader_vendor_code == gradee
  ) %>%
  select(grader, gradee, axis, win_diff_pct, ci_lower_pct, ci_upper_pct, is_diagonal)

# Create display labels for graders and gradees
heatmap_data <- heatmap_data %>%
  mutate(
    grader_label = case_when(
      grader == "human" ~ "Expert",
      grader == "jury" ~ "Jury",
      TRUE ~ grader_display_names[grader]
    ),
    gradee_label = vendor_display_names[gradee],
    grader_label = factor(grader_label, levels = grader_display_order),
    gradee_label = factor(gradee_label, levels = gradee_display_order)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(grader_label))
```

```{r heatmap_function}
create_axis_heatmap <- function(data, axis_name, panel_label, show_y_axis = TRUE) {
  plot_data <- data %>%
    filter(axis == axis_name) %>%
    mutate(
      label_pct = sprintf("%.0f%%", win_diff_pct),
      label_ci = sprintf("[%.0f, %.0f]", ci_lower_pct, ci_upper_pct)
    )

  # Identify diagonal cells for border highlighting
  diagonal_data <- plot_data %>% filter(is_diagonal)

  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = gradee_label, y = grader_label, fill = win_diff_pct)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_text(aes(label = label_pct, fontface = "bold"), size = 4, nudge_y = 0.12) +
    geom_text(aes(label = label_ci), size = 3.2, nudge_y = -0.15) +
    # Add black border for diagonal cells (self-preference)
    geom_tile(data = diagonal_data, color = "black", linewidth = 1.2, fill = NA) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "#B2182B", mid = "#F7F7F7", high = "#2166AC",
      midpoint = 0, limits = c(-100, 100),
      name = "Win difference (%)"
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(position = "bottom", drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(grader_display_order), drop = FALSE) +
    labs(
      title = axis_labels[axis_name],
      x = "Gradee (system being rated)",
      y = if (show_y_axis) "Grader (rater)" else NULL,
      tag = panel_label
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.y = if (show_y_axis) element_text() else element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = if (show_y_axis) element_text(size = 10) else element_blank(),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 12),
      plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
      plot.tag.position = c(0, 1),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid = element_blank()
    )

  return(p)
}

# Create legend-only plot
create_legend_plot <- function() {
  # Dummy data for legend
  dummy_data <- tibble(x = 1, y = 1, fill = 0)

  p_legend <- ggplot(dummy_data, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = fill)) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "#B2182B", mid = "#F7F7F7", high = "#2166AC",
      midpoint = 0, limits = c(-100, 100),
      name = "Win difference (%)",
      breaks = c(-100, -50, 0, 50, 100)
    ) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.key.height = unit(1.2, "cm"),
      legend.key.width = unit(0.4, "cm"),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 9)
    ) +
    guides(fill = guide_colorbar(title.position = "top"))

  legend <- cowplot::get_legend(p_legend)
  return(legend)
}
```

```{r heatmap_grid, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
# Create individual heatmaps
p_accuracy <- create_axis_heatmap(heatmap_data, "accuracy", "a", show_y_axis = TRUE)
p_clinical <- create_axis_heatmap(heatmap_data, "clinical_utility", "b", show_y_axis = FALSE)
p_source <- create_axis_heatmap(heatmap_data, "authoritativeness", "c", show_y_axis = FALSE)
p_verif <- create_axis_heatmap(heatmap_data, "verifiability", "d", show_y_axis = TRUE)
p_complete <- create_axis_heatmap(heatmap_data, "completeness", "e", show_y_axis = FALSE)
legend <- create_legend_plot()

# Arrange in 2x3 grid
top_row <- plot_grid(p_accuracy, p_clinical, p_source, nrow = 1, rel_widths = c(1.3, 1, 1))
bottom_row <- plot_grid(p_verif, p_complete, legend, nrow = 1, rel_widths = c(1.3, 1, 1),
                        align = "h")

final_plot <- plot_grid(top_row, bottom_row, nrow = 2)

print(final_plot)
```

# Win Rate Change vs Clinician Raters

For each LLM judge (and jury), show the absolute percent-point change in win rate
relative to human clinician raters, broken down by vendor and axis.

```{r delta_ci_bootstrap}
# Bootstrap the delta (judge favorability - human favorability) jointly over
# question clusters so the paired structure is preserved.
#
# human_df  : data.frame with columns question_id, outcome  (human outcomes)
# judge_df  : data.frame with columns question_id, outcome  (judge outcomes for one grader)
# vendor    : the vendor whose one-vs-rest outcomes to compare
# n_boot    : number of bootstrap replicates
# ci_level  : e.g. 0.95
bootstrap_delta_ci <- function(human_df, judge_df, vendor,
                                n_boot = 1000, ci_level = 0.95,
                                bootstrap_by = "question") {
  cluster_col <- if (bootstrap_by == "question") "question_id" else "user_id"

  h_ovr <- prepare_one_vs_rest_df(human_df, vendor) %>%
    rename(outcome_human = outcome)
  j_ovr <- prepare_one_vs_rest_df(judge_df, vendor) %>%
    rename(outcome_judge = outcome)

  paired <- inner_join(h_ovr, j_ovr, by = "question_id")
  if (nrow(paired) == 0) return(list(delta = NA_real_, ci_lower = NA_real_, ci_upper = NA_real_))

  obs_delta <- get_favorability_score(paired$outcome_judge) -
               get_favorability_score(paired$outcome_human)

  splits_h <- split(paired$outcome_human, paired[[cluster_col]])
  splits_j <- split(paired$outcome_judge, paired[[cluster_col]])
  n_clusters <- length(splits_h)

  boot_deltas <- replicate(n_boot, {
    idx <- sample.int(n_clusters, n_clusters, replace = TRUE)
    fav_j <- get_favorability_score(unlist(splits_j[idx], use.names = FALSE))
    fav_h <- get_favorability_score(unlist(splits_h[idx], use.names = FALSE))
    fav_j - fav_h
  })

  alpha <- 1 - ci_level
  ci <- quantile(boot_deltas, c(alpha / 2, 1 - alpha / 2), names = FALSE)
  list(delta = obs_delta, ci_lower = ci[1], ci_upper = ci[2])
}
```

```{r delta_ci_compute}
# Build paired raw data: human and each judge share the same question pool.
# human_text_only has columns: question_id, slot_a_vendor, slot_b_vendor,
#   winner, loser, is_tie, axis (among others).
# machine_text_only has the same columns plus grader.

delta_ci_rows <- list()
for (g in unique(machine_text_only$grader)) {
  judge_df_full <- machine_text_only %>% filter(grader == g)
  for (ax in axes) {
    human_ax  <- human_text_only %>% filter(axis == ax)
    judge_ax  <- judge_df_full    %>% filter(axis == ax)
    vendors_ax <- sort(unique(c(human_ax$slot_a_vendor, human_ax$slot_b_vendor)))
    for (v in vendors_ax) {
      res <- bootstrap_delta_ci(
        human_ax, judge_ax, v,
        n_boot        = params$n_boot,
        ci_level      = 0.95,
        bootstrap_by  = params$bootstrap_by
      )
      delta_ci_rows[[length(delta_ci_rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
        judge  = g,
        axis   = ax,
        vendor = v,
        delta  = res$delta,
        ci_lower_delta = res$ci_lower,
        ci_upper_delta = res$ci_upper
      )
    }
  }
}

# Also compute for the jury
for (ax in axes) {
  human_ax <- human_text_only %>% filter(axis == ax)
  jury_ax  <- jury_ratings      %>% filter(axis == ax)
  vendors_ax <- sort(unique(c(human_ax$slot_a_vendor, human_ax$slot_b_vendor)))
  for (v in vendors_ax) {
    res <- bootstrap_delta_ci(
      human_ax, jury_ax, v,
      n_boot       = params$n_boot,
      ci_level     = 0.95,
      bootstrap_by = params$bootstrap_by
    )
    delta_ci_rows[[length(delta_ci_rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
      judge  = "jury",
      axis   = ax,
      vendor = v,
      delta  = res$delta,
      ci_lower_delta = res$ci_lower,
      ci_upper_delta = res$ci_upper
    )
  }
}

delta_ci_df <- bind_rows(delta_ci_rows)
```

```{r winrate_delta_plot, fig.width=12, fig.height=14}
# Compute delta: judge win rate minus human win rate (in percentage points).
# Join bootstrapped CIs from delta_ci_df (computed above).
human_fav <- all_favorability %>%
  filter(judge == "human") %>%
  select(axis, vendor, human_fav = favorability)

delta_data <- all_favorability %>%
  filter(judge != "human") %>%
  left_join(human_fav, by = c("axis", "vendor")) %>%
  left_join(delta_ci_df, by = c("judge", "axis", "vendor")) %>%
  mutate(
    delta_pct    = 100 * (favorability - human_fav),
    ci_lo_pct    = 100 * ci_lower_delta,
    ci_hi_pct    = 100 * ci_upper_delta,
    judge_label  = case_when(
      judge == "jury" ~ "Jury",
      TRUE ~ grader_display_names[judge]
    ),
    axis_label   = axis_labels[axis],
    vendor_label = vendor_display_names[vendor]
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(judge_label)) %>%
  mutate(
    judge_label  = factor(judge_label, levels = c(
      grader_display_order[grader_display_order != "Expert"], "Jury"
    )),
    axis_label   = factor(axis_label,   levels = axis_labels),
    vendor_label = factor(vendor_label, levels = gradee_display_order)
  )

# One panel per judge (rows), bars grouped by axis, colored by vendor
delta_plot <- ggplot(delta_data,
                     aes(x = axis_label, y = delta_pct, fill = vendor_label)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), width = 0.65) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = ci_lo_pct, ymax = ci_hi_pct),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
    width = 0.25, linewidth = 0.5, color = "grey20"
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4, color = "grey30") +
  facet_wrap(~ judge_label, ncol = 1, strip.position = "right") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2", name = "Vendor") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = function(x) paste0(ifelse(x > 0, "+", ""), x, "%")
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = "Difference in Win Rates, LLM Judges vs. Clinician Raters",
    x        = NULL,
    y        = "Win rate change (pp)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    strip.text.y       = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0, face = "bold", size = 11),
    axis.text.x        = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1, size = 10),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    legend.position    = "bottom",
    plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    plot.subtitle      = element_text(size = 10, color = "grey40")
  )

print(delta_plot)
```

# Win Rate Change Heatmap vs Clinician Raters

Same layout as above, using tile color (red–white–blue) and text labels instead of bar
height.  Uses the bootstrapped `delta_ci_df` computed above.

```{r winrate_delta_heatmap, fig.width=12.5, fig.height=4}
# 5-column × 4-row grid: facet columns = preference axes, x = vendor, y = judge.
delta_heatmap_data <- delta_ci_df %>%
  mutate(
    delta_pct    = 100 * delta,
    ci_lo_pct    = 100 * ci_lower_delta,
    ci_hi_pct    = 100 * ci_upper_delta,
    label_main   = sprintf("%+.0f%%", delta_pct),
    label_ci     = case_when(
      !is.na(ci_lo_pct) ~ sprintf("[%+.0f, %+.0f]", ci_lo_pct, ci_hi_pct),
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),
    judge_label  = case_when(
      judge == "jury" ~ "Combined Jury",
      TRUE ~ paste0("Judge: ", grader_display_names[judge])
    ),
    axis_label   = factor(axis_labels[axis],            levels = axis_labels),
    vendor_label = factor(vendor_display_names[vendor], levels = gradee_display_order)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(judge_label)) %>%
  mutate(
    judge_label = factor(judge_label, levels = c(
      paste0("Judge: ", grader_display_order[grader_display_order != "Expert"]), "Combined Jury"
    ))
  )

delta_heatmap_plot <- ggplot(
    delta_heatmap_data,
    aes(x = vendor_label, y = axis_label, fill = delta_pct)
  ) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(
      label = label_main,
      color = if_else(abs(delta_pct) > 35, "white", "black"),
      fontface = "bold"
    ),
            size = 3.2, nudge_y = 0.13) +
  geom_text(aes(
      label = label_ci,
      color = if_else(abs(delta_pct) > 35, "grey80", "grey20"),
    ),
            size = 2.4, nudge_y = -0.15) +
  facet_grid(~ judge_label) +
  scale_color_identity() + 
  scale_fill_distiller(
    palette = "PuOr",
    direction = 1,
    name     = "Win Rate\nDifference (pp)",
    breaks   = c(-50, -25, 0, 25, 50),
    limits   = c(-50, 50),
    oob      = scales::squish
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(position = "bottom") +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(levels(delta_heatmap_data$axis_label))) +
  labs(
    title    = "Difference in Win Rates, LLM Judges vs. Clinician Raters",
    x        = "Response Model",
    y        = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    strip.text.x      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    axis.text.x       = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.y       = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 11, margin = margin(t = 12)),
    panel.grid        = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing     = unit(0.4, "cm"),
    legend.position   = "right",
    legend.key.height = unit(1.2, "cm"),
    legend.key.width  = unit(0.4, "cm"),
    plot.title        = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    plot.subtitle     = element_text(size = 10, color = "grey40")
  )

print(delta_heatmap_plot)
```

```{r save_delta_heatmap}
ggsave(
  file.path(output_dir, paste0(params$output_name, "_winrate_delta_heatmap.pdf")),
  delta_heatmap_plot, width = 14, height = 5
)
ggsave(
  file.path(output_dir, paste0(params$output_name, "_winrate_delta_heatmap.png")),
  delta_heatmap_plot, width = 14, height = 5, dpi = 300
)
```
